changelog: Diagnostic release: the previous v3.96 logging never fired, so this adds (1) a startup marker logging which build is actually running (an OTA install doesn't take effect in an already-running process until it's restarted), (2) logging for the mini player's own separate reconnect-retry loop, and (3) a 20s buffering-stall watchdog log for stalls that never trigger an error or STATE_ENDED event. Still no user-facing changes.
